```{python}
#| label: fig-exclusion-wire-through-ports-schematic
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "The netlist of `exclusion_wire_through` with `ports`. In green what replaces the resistor of `ignore`, struck through in red: a resistor outside the marker on each side, up to a port at each cut. Dashed, the model of what the marker stands for, which is no part of this netlist."
import schemdraw as sd
import schemdraw.elements as elm
import schemdraw.flow as flow
import schemdraw.segments as seg
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

def strike_through(drawing: sd.Drawing,
                   element: elm.Element):
    hw = 0.5  # half width
    hh = 0.5  # half height

    p_lower_left = element.center[0] - hw, element.center[1] - hh
    p_upper_right = element.center[0] + hw, element.center[1] + hh
    d.add(elm.Line().at(p_lower_left).to(p_upper_right).color('red').linewidth(2))

with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=2)
    d.config(fontsize=16)

    A = elm.Dot(open=True).label('A', loc='top', ofst=(-0.3, 0))
    R1 = elm.Resistor().right().length(3.5).at(A.center).label('$0.858\\,\\Omega$').color('green')
    P0 = elm.Dot(open=True).color('green')
    elm.Line().right().length(0.6).at(P0.center).linestyle('--')
    M = flow.Box(w=2.4, h=1.2).anchor('W').label('model').linestyle('--')
    elm.Line().right().length(0.6).at(M.E).linestyle('--')
    P1 = elm.Dot(open=True).color('green')
    R2 = elm.Resistor().right().length(3.5).at(P1.center).label('$0.858\\,\\Omega$').color('green')
    B = elm.Dot(open=True).label('B', loc='top', ofst=(0.3, 0))
    CA = elm.Capacitor().down().at(A.center).length(3).label('$0.951\\,\\mathrm{fF}$').dot()
    C0 = elm.Capacitor().down().at(P0.center).length(3).label('$0.845\\,\\mathrm{fF}$').color('green').dot()
    C1 = elm.Capacitor().down().at(P1.center).length(3).label('$0.845\\,\\mathrm{fF}$', loc='bottom').color('green').dot()
    CB = elm.Capacitor().down().at(B.center).length(3).label('$0.951\\,\\mathrm{fF}$', loc='bottom').dot()
    elm.Line().endpoints(CA.end, C0.end)
    Rail = elm.Line().endpoints(C0.end, C1.end)
    elm.Line().endpoints(C1.end, CB.end)
    S = elm.Dot().at(Rail.center).label('sub!', loc='bottom', ofst=(0.5, 0))
    elm.Line().down().at(S.center).length(0.3)
    elm.Ground()
    elm.Label().at((P0.center[0], P0.center[1] + 1.0)).label('A_B__m0_0').color('green')
    elm.Label().at((P1.center[0], P1.center[1] + 1.0)).label('A_B__m0_1').color('green')
    RT = elm.Resistor().left().at(A.center).length(2.6).label('$1\\,\\mathrm{m\\Omega}$')
    elm.Dot().label('A|B', loc='top')
    elm.Line().up().at(A.center).length(2)
    Old = elm.Resistor().right().length(B.center[0] - A.center[0]).label('$2.596\\,\\Omega$', ofst=0.5)
    elm.Line().down().length(2)
    strike_through(d, Old)
```
